schema_version.description: 1.1.0 (Glen, 2026-09-24) retires the C rating: a comp is A or B with its reason or excluded with its reason; a C on a 1.1.0 document is an error in checks/comps.py, on a 1.0.0 document a warning until its next edit.

rows.description: Empty is legal ONLY on a land deal, where there are no residential units to compare. checks/comps.py restores the floor of one for every other deal_type, because this document cannot see deal.json and must not become the place a multifamily BOV loses its rent evidence.

quality_rating.description: A and B are the tiers of a comp judged in against the subject. C is retired (Glen, 09/23/2026); it stays in this enum only so 1.0.0 documents still validate, and checks/comps.py refuses it on a 1.1.0 document. "exclude" removes the row from the site entirely, not just from the weighting: payload.py drops it before rendering, so it leaves the table, the medians and the map pins. A comp that must appear on the page, including an active-competition listing, is never rated exclude. An excluded comp must also carry weight 0 and appear in conclusions.excluded_ids.

listing_url.description: The advertisement this asking rent was read off. When present the comp address links here instead of to its Google Maps pin, so a reader can check the figure at its source. Absent falls back to the pin link, which is what every comp did before this existed. Must be an absolute http(s) URL with a real host. A scheme-only string such as 'https://' would otherwise be preferred over the working map-pin fallback and publish a dead link on a client page (Codex P2 on #451).
